chunks: Yunus, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The testimony of women is valid regarding virginity and every defect that men cannot look at.
ai.seo_question: Is the testimony of women valid for establishing virginity in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that women's testimony is legally valid in 'udrah (virginity) and 'ayb (defects) cases, particularly where male witnesses cannot observe due to modesty (hijab) or anatomical specificity. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that testimony validity depends on the witness's ability to perceive the specific matter, ensuring gender-appropriate verification in family law matters.
